summary: Ellipsiz DSS Pte Ltd is a distribution and service solutions provider specializing in semiconductor equipment and services across the Asia Pacific region. They offer a comprehensive range of products including wafer fabrication equipment, board level test equipment, and fab support services. Their focus is on enhancing and innovating customer solutions to meet core and peripheral needs in the semiconductor industry.
